title: *NEW* WEEKEND TRAVEL VLOG 🏡 | Cleaning, organising & preparing to go away again! | Jess and Tribe
description:
*NEW* WEEKEND TRAVEL VLOG 🏡 | Cleaning, organising & preparing to go away again! | Jess and Tribe

Hey loves!! We've been taking lots of little road trips lately and have been loving it!! 🙌🏼
In today's video we're preparing to go away again so we'll be cleaning, organising the house & packing ready for our next adventure!! 
We're going away with family and friends to Ballarat for a couple of nights to go to the Sovereign Hill Winter Wonderlights show ✨❄️☃️
I took the kids to this show 5 years ago and we absolutely loved it, it's such a magical experience so I highly recommend it to you guys! I'll link a card to that video and save it in the description box too. 
I also vlogged a little while we were there on this trip, which you'll see in my next video!
I hope you all enjoy, please remember to like, subscribe, share this video with your family & friends as it really helps my channel, hit your bell notification button so you never miss a video + follow me on Instagram.
♡ Jess xx
